headline: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to draft plans from workplace talk
summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Meetings, letting Claude draft plans, map timelines on a whiteboard, answer questions in chat, and pull in connected work apps as participants talk during meetings. Outlets differ on whether the feature is already available or still coming soon with limitations.

claims.statement: Anthropic introduced Claude Meetings, which can draft plans and tasks from workplace discussions.

sources.quote: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
Claude can collaborate in your team meetings soon – like an intern

claims.statement: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map a timeline on a whiteboard, answer chat questions, and retrieve information from connected work apps.

sources.quote: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.

claims.statement: Anthropic also launched two more new features that are available now.

sources.quote: Anthropic launches two more new features that are available now.

discrepancies.explanation: One outlet's headline presents Claude Meetings as already launched, while another frames it as coming soon with limitations.

quotes.quote: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
Claude is responding ‘Yes’ to that calendar invite – with some limitations.
